content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike detected on prompt-bridge-prod route. 5xx rate increased to 8% over 5m, p95 latency jumped to 1.4s. Alert rules: prompt-bridge-error-rate, prompt-bridge-p95-latency. Investigate please.

Maggie (oncall): seeing it. I’m paging SRE and eng-runtime. paging @Santiago @Kevin. putting incident-low -> incident-high.

Santiago: on it. quick question — did a canary finish recently for prompt-bridge-v2? I see a deploy at 16:02 UTC.

Kevin: yes, deploy finished ~16:02. canary was 10% traffic to prompt-bridge-v2 (experimental routing). telemetry shows error spike coincident with cutover.

Emma (support): flag: we have 2 customers reporting elevated 429/500s in last 10m. ticket #INC-4329 created. we'll start proactive outreach if we confirm.

Maggie (oncall): ok let's do a firebreak: flip the experiment flag that routes to prompt-bridge-v2 back to stable. Runbook: "prod-feature-flag-emergency-cut". Maggie (oncall): executing command: ```/ff toggle prompt_bridge_v2 route:false --who=maggie```

OpsRunbooksBot: Action logged: prompt_bridge_v2 set to route:false by Maggie (oncall) at 2026-03-15T16:12:03Z. Previous state: route:true. Propagation to edge ~20s.

Santiago: seeing propagation. traffic percent to v2 dropping: 10% -> 2% -> 0% (10s intervals). errors on v1 temporarily unchanged but overall 5xx is decreasing.

Kevin: confirming, p95 latency now 420ms (was 1400ms). 5xx down from 8% -> 2.1% in last 2 minutes. good signal.

Emma (support): pausing outbound customer notifications for now, will update tickets: "We observed increased failures for prompt routing after a canary. Engineering pulled the experimental route and we're monitoring; we'll follow up in 30m with timeline." #INC-4329

Maggie (oncall): I want a quick postmortem checklist: root cause hypothesis, timeline, impact, rollback steps, signal thresholds for auto-firebreak. @Kevin can you capture logs from 15:58-16:14 UTC and share any stack traces?

Kevin: grabbing logs, filtering for prompt-bridge request_id. found repeated 500s from model-adapter: "kv cache miss followed by OOM in quant executor" — attaching snippet: ```ERROR model-adapter - OOM during quantize step: worker-1234, trace: ...``` Might be bad kernel selection with certain sequence lengths.

Santiago: that matches profiling — v2 used a new kernel compilation profile which regressed for long sequences. So feature flag flip avoided broader impact, but we should pin v2 to a reduced seq length and recompile kernels.

Maggie (oncall): handoff: night oncall @Vijay, I’m running the incident checklist and will stay until handoff done. Vijay, summary: experimental prompt_bridge_v2 caused kernel/quant OOMs on some sequences; we toggled feature flag (prompt_bridge_v2.route=false) at 2026-03-15T16:12:03Z. Metrics improving. Please watch p95, 5xx, and model-adapter OOMs for the next 2 hours. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-feature-flag-emergency-cut

Vijay (night-oncall): ack, taking handoff. I’ll create a short watch dashboard and set alerts at p95>600ms or 5xx>3% to wake me. Also will coordinate with runtime team for the kernel patch tomorrow morning.

Emma (support): customer update posted: "Engineering rolled back the experimental prompt routing flag; we're monitoring. ETA for a full postmortem 24h." :white_check_mark:

Maggie (oncall): added blocker to rollout backlog: "re-evaluate kernel selection logic for v2, add canary traffic lower bound, add automated smoke for long sequences before cutover." Assigned to Santiago and Kevin.

Kevin: will add an automated regression test that sends long-sequence prompts through canary and checks memory/latency before promoting.

Santiago: for immediate mitigation, propose adding a temporary warmup: pre-populate KV cache for long-seq patterns during canary. low-risk and might reduce OOMs.

Maggie (oncall): good idea. if Rafael on runtime agrees, add to tomorrow's sprint. For now, close the active alert group if no regressions in 30m.

incident-bot: Alert group: prompt-bridge-prod-resolved if metrics remain < threshold for 30m. Next check at 16:42 UTC.

Vijay (night-oncall): watching. I’ll escalate to oncall-sre if any threshold breach. good handoff, Maggie. :thumbsup:

Maggie (oncall): thanks all. I’ll add incident notes and link logs + timeline, and escalate to postmortem if customer impact > 5 customers or any P1 tickets open. otherwise this will be an ops incident with follow-up tasks.

Emma (support): INC-4329 updated and customer-facing note queued.

Kevin: logs and trace export link: https://redwood.internal/logs?query=prompt-bridge&from=2026-03-15T15:58&to=2026-03-15T16:14

Santiago: creating PR for kernel pin + canary smoke tests, will reference this thread in description.

Maggie (oncall): last note before handoff: retain debug-level model-adapter logs for +2h to capture any late errors, then rotate down to info. done.

incident-bot: Reminder: file a short incident summary in #postmortems if any customer impact > 1 or if flag toggles were performed."
